b: How does >x< use the emails that creators receive?

b: Can >x< share or delete my email address after I share it?

runs: >x< has no further control over an email address once it shares it with a creator. >x< deletes the email address you share from its systems.

runs: Creators are entirely responsible for complying with any laws, including, for example, by maintaining a privacy policy and following any marketing laws. See the terms for responsibilities.

b: Do I need to share my email with all creators I subscribe to or can I choose which ones to share with?
